opening.argument: The offer is a free $100 Nike gift card for one participating follower, with entry tied to familiar contest actions: liking the Facebook page and contest post and tagging a friend. Sharing is suggested to increase visibility. Nothing in the stated instructions asks viewers to invest, pay, provide credentials, or submit personal data. The announcement does not establish whether the contest took place or whether anyone received the prize, but that uncertainty alone does not change what is presented: a promotional giveaway based on ordinary social-media engagement.

citations.quote: We. Will be giving away a free $100 Nike gift card to one follower who actively. Participates on our page.
Like our Facebook Contest post (Share the post to increase your visibility)
Once you've done that, like our page, like our. Facebook contest post and tag a friend under the post.
